run: five arms on the SAVED seed-0 PC checkpoint (+ model_s3.pt census) under g5.36's train-only solve and scoring, IMPORTED unchanged from osc_neuron_period_cut.py (feats, solve, install, arm, rand_pick); forward passes, least squares and greedy selection only, 0 gradient steps, NO training, NO data download

model.note: 1 layer: tokens (a, b, '=') with '=' = id 113; causal attention (no biases on Q/K/V/O), MLP W_in+b_in -> ReLU -> W_out+b_out, residual stream only (no LayerNorm), unembed (no bias) read at the '=' position (index 2) -> logits over 113 classes = (a+b) mod 113. Init: W_E, W_pos ~ N(0, 1/d_model); Linear layers PyTorch default

split_def: all 113*113 pairs (a, b), index a*113+b; numpy default_rng(split_seed).permutation; first floor(0.3*12769) = 3830 = train, the rest (8939) = held-out test
pipeline: IMPORTED unchanged: S = osc_neuron_period_pc (make, data, sweep, stat, null, evaluate), T = osc_neuron_period_seeds.families, F = osc_neuron_period_p4fair (sha, rp); peakiness pk and dominant bin per neuron as in the PC; families = the P1 neurons (pk > null q999 AND pk > twin max) grouped by dominant frequency, every family of >= family_floor neurons, ordered by size desc (ties smallest k). Key frequencies are COMPUTED by the run (expected 5, 1, 45, 34 from the PC's P2 tally), never typed in
solve_def: for a kept set K of N neurons: h = post-ReLU at '=' on the TRAIN rows (3830), Phi = [h[:, K], 1] (N+1 columns); target T = the full net's train logits minus its non-MLP path (L - U(W_out h + b_out)); M = lstsq(Phi, T) in float64 (gelsd, min-norm), the logit-space readout; W' = M pinv(U^T) (the residual-stream W_out rows + b_out); the cut net = a copy with W_out[:, K] = W'[:N]^T, every other W_out column 0, b_out = W'[N]; scored by the model's own forward pass on the 8939 held-out rows (S.evaluate). 0 gradient steps
u_def: void if max |W' U^T - M| > u_tol (U^T must be invertible on the logit space)
self_check: the same solve with ALL 512 neurons must reproduce the full net: |held-out acc(cut 512) - baseline| <= self_tol, else VOID
random_pick_def: seed s: numpy default_rng(s).permutation(512); the first N entries (nested sets: the N=8 set is inside the N=16 set); over ALL 512 neurons; every index set is written to results.json

s3.note: memorized, NOT grokked: train 1.0, held-out 0.024 at step 14900 (results_s3.json); sha read 11-05 before this commit

n_grid_note: claims are scored at N in n_grid (<= 32); the random arm also runs at 48 and 64 (the leaf) so N_r >= 2 x N_b is decidable for N_b <= 32
arm_a: RANDOM: seed s in random_seeds, Z.rand_pick = default_rng(s).permutation(512)[:N] (nested); N_r = the smallest N in n_grid + n_grid_random_extra where ANY seed reaches acc_threshold held-out (none -> > 64)
phase_def: per family neuron i of family frequency k: A = its post-ReLU at '=' over ALL 12769 (a, b) inputs (inputs only, no labels), laid out A[a, b]; Fq = numpy fft2(A) (axis 0 = a, axis 1 = b); phi_a = angle(Fq[k, 0]), phi_b = angle(Fq[0, k])
R_def: R(theta) = |mean_j exp(i theta_j)| (mean resultant length); within ONE family (phases at different frequencies are not comparable): R_sum = R(phi_a + phi_b), R_diff = R(phi_a - phi_b) over that family's kept neurons
quota_def: n_k by largest remainder on the computed family tally: q_k = N c_k / sum c; floor; the remaining seats to the largest fractional parts, ties -> family order (size desc, smallest k)
arm_b: JOINT-PHASE pick: per family k, greedy n_k steps, each adding the candidate that MINIMISES max(R_sum, R_diff) of (kept + candidate); ties within 1e-12 -> smallest index (so the first pick of every family = its smallest index, where all candidates tie at R = 1)
arm_c: CEILING: greedy OMP on the TRAIN rows only: the intercept is always in; each step adds the neuron (of all 512) whose column, orthogonalised against the kept set, most cuts the Frobenius residual of the solve's own target (train logits - non-MLP path); columns with orthogonal energy <= 1e-9 x their own energy (dead / dependent) are skipped; ties -> smallest index; nested in N
arm_d: WRITE, DON'T PICK: per computed key frequency k (the families, expected 5, 1, 45, 34), m neurons; neuron j targets z_j = cos(2 pi k a / p + phi_j) + cos(2 pi k b / p + psi_j) as its PRE-activation, (phi_j, psi_j) = the rank-1 lattice (2 pi j / m, 2 pi (j g mod m) / m), j = 0..m-1, g = the integer coprime to m nearest m / 1.618 (m 2/4/6/8 -> g 1/3/5/5; council pin, thought-master [amend] 11:14Z); input weights (w, b) = lstsq([r, 1], z) on the TRAIN rows, r = the residual stream at '=' (the MLP's input); written into a COPY's w_in rows 0..N_w-1, the neuron = ReLU(w.r + b); W_out by g5.36's solve (Z.arm, keep = those rows); m in write_m, N_w = 4 m
arm_e: model_s3.pt census: train / held-out baseline, P1 + family tally (the PC pipeline, floor family_floor); then (a), (c) and, if it has families, (b), with the solve onto ITS OWN train logits, scored on TRAIN rows as a fraction of its own train baseline
H1: PROVED iff (b) reaches acc_threshold held-out at N_b <= 32 (N_b = the smallest n_grid N) AND (N_r > 64 or N_r >= 2 x N_b); else DISPROVED (RED). VOID if M1, M2 or M4 is not RED
H2: RED iff (c) reaches acc_threshold at N_c (smallest n_grid N) below N_b; if (b) never reaches it at N <= 32, N_b := '>32' and RED iff (c) reaches it at any N <= 32; if NEITHER reaches it, H2 = no_verdict (council pin 11:14Z); else NOT RED. VOID if M2 is not RED
H3: PROVED iff some N_w <= 32 has (d) held-out acc >= acc_threshold AND (c) at that same N < acc_threshold; else DISPROVED (RED). VOID if M3 is not RED
M1: phase-twin pick: same n_k, per family greedy MAXIMISING R_sum (ties smallest index); RED iff held-out acc < acc_threshold at every n_grid N
M2: init twin (S.make(P, twin_seed), untrained) under the same solve onto the TRAINED net's train logits, every pick: the trained net's (a) at n_grid, (b) and (c) index sets, and OMP run on the twin's own features; RED iff every held-out acc < m2_max_acc ((a)-(c) only, council pin 11:14Z; (d) on the twin is item 5 and never voids H3)
M3: equal-phase write: phi_j = psi_j = 0 for every j at m = max(write_m) (N_w = 32); RED iff held-out acc < m3_max_acc
M4: model_s3.pt: RED iff (c) and (b) (when it has families) each keep < m4_keep_frac of s3's own TRAIN baseline (TRAIN rows) at every n_grid N
item5: REPORTED, no claim: (d) on the random-init twin (its residual probed the same way, the solve onto the trained net's train logits)
verdict_rule: run-level VOID (every claim void) if a checkpoint sha256 differs, the PC baseline < acc_threshold, the 512 self-check is off by > self_tol, any u error > u_tol, the wall cap hits, or params.json changed since launch; else each claim per H1 / H2 / H3 with its mutant gates
